note: Working numbers, not confirmed prices. Every value says where it came from. 'verified' means read from the entity's own page; 'document' means it came from Frank's 7 Sep 2026 business plan document and has not been verified from the entity's page; 'hub' means it came from the Executive Master Hub page Frank pasted 8 Sep 2026, written by an independent AI that researched the market, whose sources are not in hand; 'assumption' means nobody has a source.

prices.talkerOneTime.note: Core Talker one-time price in Frank's 7 Sep document. The earlier model used $79.99. Not confirmed.

prices.tetherMonthly.note: Connected Family Tether monthly price in Frank's 7 Sep document. The earlier model used $12.99. Not confirmed.

prices.tetherYearly.note: Yearly option in Frank's document. Not used in the projection; the yearly share is unknown.

prices.schoolList.note: EZvoxa Pro list price per seat in Frank's document. Frank, 8 Sep 2026: EZvoxa Pro is its own App Store listing, for schools and clinicians, at the higher rate. Not confirmed.

prices.schoolVolume.note: Frank, 8 Sep 2026: Pro is sold direct from our website so he can negotiate by the size of the purchase. There is no fixed volume price. $124.99 at 20 or more seats stays in the model only as a stand-in for what negotiated large orders might average; Frank sets the real number deal by deal.

costs.storeCommission.note: Apple Small Business Program 15% under $1M a year; Google Play 15% on the first $1M. Read from Apple's and Google's help pages 4 Sep 2026.

costs.revenueCatRate.note: RevenueCat's own pricing page, 7 Sep 2026: 1% of tracked revenue once past $2,500 a month.

costs.revenueCatFreeMonthly.note: Same page: nothing up to $2,500 in monthly tracked revenue.

costs.refundRate.note: About 4% refund and chargeback leakage, carried over from the 15 Aug model, which cited a vendor benchmark that does not pass the sourcing rule.

costs.acquisitionPerBuyer.note: About $12 blended cost per buyer, carried over from the 15 Aug model as a labeled assumption.

costs.textCostEach.note: Twilio US SMS page, 5 Sep 2026: $0.0083 per outbound segment plus up to $0.005 carrier fee, one segment.

costs.alertCostEach.note: Same page; an SOS text with a map link is two segments, to one person.

costs.voicePerFamilyMonth.note: Per-family monthly cost of the natural voice after the 7 Sep server memory (each phrase paid once). Not measured yet; placeholder.

costs.twilioNumberMonthly.note: Twilio US page, 5 Sep 2026: leased long code $1.15 a month.

costs.tenDlcOneTime.note: $4 brand plus $15 campaign registration in Frank's document. Twilio's page says 10DLC fees apply but does not show the amounts; not verified.

costs.vercelMonthly.note: Vercel Pro $20 a month in Frank's document. Not read from Vercel's page.

costs.codemagicMonthly.note: Free tier with 500 build minutes a month in Frank's document. Not read from Codemagic's page.

costs.appleDeveloperYearly.note: Apple Developer Program, $99 a year, Apple's enrollment page.

costs.googlePlayOneTime.note: Google Play Console registration, $25 one-time, recorded in the ledger from Google's page.

assumptions.textsPerFamilyPerMonth.note: How many texts a family sends a month. No data until real families use it.

assumptions.alertsPerFamilyPerYear.note: How many SOS alerts a family sends a year. No data. The alert is free to the family; this is our cost.

assumptions.schoolsThroughStore.note: Frank, 8 Sep 2026: Pro is sold by EZ Voice direct, districts and clinics included, so no store commission on those seats. The 7 Sep document had them going through Apple School Manager and Google Play; superseded.

scenarios.note: Buyers, year-end subscribers, districts, seats per district and operating expenses per year for Floor, Mid and Ceiling are the ramps in Frank's 7 Sep document, which follow the 15 Aug model's labeled assumptions. Year 1 is the free pilot at Evan's school. National is separate: see scenarios.national.

scenarios.national.note: The national ramp from the Executive Master Hub page Frank pasted 8 Sep 2026, written by an independent AI that researched the market after reviewing the product's screenshots and demo; its sources are not in hand. Buyers, year-end subscribers, districts with their seat totals, and clinical seats (therapists, per Frank 8 Sep) with theirs, priced at the school rate as the page prices them. Its operating column was labeled OpEx and RC; the model computes RevenueCat itself, so operating here is that column minus 1% of the page's own gross (buyers times $99.99 plus year-end subscribers times $9.99 times twelve), which leaves round figures of $34,500, $53,700, $81,700, $114,700 and $147,700.

costs.directSalesShare.note: Cost of selling EZvoxa Pro direct, as a share of Pro sales: sales time, travel, conferences, invoicing, collections. Added 9 Sep 2026 on Frank's go after the widget check found direct-sold seats carried no selling cost at all. 10% is a placeholder, Frank's to set; applies only when Pro seats are sold direct (the store checkbox off).
